onyx-canvas.$description: Onyx Canvas — Page background, primary surface

carbon-surface.$description: Carbon Surface — Elevated card, input field, subtle surface layer

graphite-surface.$description: Graphite Surface — Mid-elevation panels, nested surfaces

smoke-surface.$description: Smoke Surface — Hover state, deeper card, button surface tone

iron-surface.$description: Iron Surface — Pressed/active surface, highest tier elevation

ash-border.$description: Ash Border — Primary hairline border — dividers, table rows, list separators

ferrite-border.$description: Ferrite Border — Inner shadow stroke, focus-adjacent borders, subtle 1px outlines

steel-text.$description: Steel Text — Tertiary text, icon muted state, low-emphasis helper text

pewter-text.$description: Pewter Text — Disabled text, placeholder-tier secondary content

fog-text.$description: Fog Text — Muted body text, metadata, timestamps, nav sub-items

mist-text.$description: Mist Text — Secondary text, descriptions, list body, paragraph fallback

chalk-border.$description: Chalk Border — Light icon accent, rare light-tone dividers

snow.$description: Snow — Primary text, headings, logo, pill button border — the only near-white

void.$description: Void — Deepest recess, box-shadow tint, absolute dark accent

inter-variable.$description: Primary typeface across all UI. Weight 590 is the signature display weight — the half-step past 500/600 gives Linear a tighter, more controlled visual rhythm than typical 600-bold headlines. Used for body, nav, headings, buttons, icons, links, and footer.

berkeley-mono.$description: Monospace accent for inline code references, command examples, and technical callouts (e.g., 'Granolio - create issues from my last meeting'). Its presence signals developer-grade precision without screaming for attention.
